sources.content: Curator paraphrase of StockCharts Calculation and Interpretation: the long Chandelier level subtracts three ATR values from the highest high over twenty-two periods; the short level adds three ATR values to the lowest low. ATR uses Wilder smoothing. Twenty-two and three are conventional daily defaults, not universal settings. Rolling extrema and changing volatility can move a long line down or a short line up; this calculation is not a favorable-only monotonic stop ratchet. Chandelier supplies an exit framework that complements an independently chosen entry method. It does not establish the profitability of an entry or a shorter execution timeframe.

sources.content: Curator paraphrase of the reviewed Plan Your Escape transcript pages: a trailing stop follows favorable movement while avoiding movement that increases the permitted loss. A stop trigger does not guarantee its execution price; market conditions and gaps affect fills. A stop-limit adds a price constraint and may remain unfilled. Position sizing connects an explicit cash amount at risk with the distance between entry and stop. These considerations distinguish a management plan from a guarantee of loss containment or profit. They support risk and execution literacy; they do not prescribe the laboratory's fixed twenty-two-period Chandelier, its three-ATR multiplier or its M5 closing rule.

operating_steps: Keep the independent frozen entry, initial risk, protective stop and final target. Evaluate this exit only on an already owned position using original completed OHLC.
Compute rolling highest high and lowest low over twenty-two observations and arithmetic-seeded Wilder ATR22. Require complete finite levels and strictly positive ATR.

For a BUY-held position, a closed price strictly below highest-high22 minus three ATR22 requests a full close; for SELL, a closed price strictly above lowest-low22 plus three ATR22 requests it. Equality waits.
Apply the selected scalar regime/session/volatility predicate to the CURRENT exit-decision context, not the position's entry context. The same position may cross those boundaries.

Execute a requested close at the following indexed open through the existing executor and its native open-gap stop/target guard. Retain native protection when this exit is unavailable or outside scope.
Compare cost-inclusive realized cash on each whole continuous account with its exact control. Preserve initial geometry, physical costs, missing inputs, maturity and every original outcome.
wait_when: No owned position, incomplete original OHLC or clock, immature levels, nonfinite values, nonpositive ATR or equality at the Chandelier boundary cannot request a typed close.
Low volatility or missing/unknown regime, session or volatility uses policy BASELINE; native protective stop and take-profit remain active.
Outside an exact scalar method scope uses BASELINE. This does not classify the omitted context as safe, harmful or economically qualified.
limitations: The executable method is the existing fixed 22/3 Chandelier closed-price full-exit operator, not a new entry algorithm or a favorable-only ratcheting stop. Its rolling line may fall or rise as the window and ATR change.

Daily defaults applied to M5 observations and a closed-price cross followed by execution at the following open are explicit laboratory adaptations, not reproduced publisher market results. Equality and missing observations cannot trigger a typed exit.

Each append-only alternative covers one current exit-decision regime, legacy session and normal/high volatility. Context is not frozen at entry; low or missing context uses BASELINE with the native protective stop/TP retained. Transition is an eligible management context, not permission to create a transition entry.

Native prior-closed ATR trailing ratchets the protective stop and is a separate algorithm. The hybrid combines that physical ratchet with the typed Chandelier exit, retaining native gap-stop/target pricing. Time-stop precedence and existing OHLC intrabar assumptions remain unchanged.

Initial stop 1.5 management ATR, final target 2.5 management ATR, partial fraction zero and time stop zero stay identical across the declared arms. Only native_atr_ratchet and hybrid set trailing ATR multiplier to 2.0. Entry parameters, sizing/risk rules, initial account, leverage and execution costs are unchanged; realized entry sequence and sizes can diverge through existing account state, position availability and adaptive cooldown after different exits.

This panel uses full closes only. Existing weighted partial bookkeeping is not a genuine realized-cash partial-close ledger, releases no partial cash and does not support per-leg fee/carry or fill claims.

Primary economics are cost-inclusive realized cash at close, not marked-equity drawdown. Ordinary cash equity curves sample completed closes; full exit-bar MFE/MAE are OHLC bounds with unknown path order, not true intrabar capture or stop-efficiency proof.

Legacy London excludes overlap; overlap takes calendar precedence. Asia and remaining new_york labels retain the existing calendar and IANA/DST interpretation; scopes never force a candle into a desired session.

The proposed four-window panel uses previously seen pre-2026 archive. Windows, contexts and sixteen originals do not establish independent validation, causal or earned skill, Master status, economic credit, stronger-child qualification, promotion, paper or live authority. All 2026 and later market data remain paper-only.

Every original is attempted at most once. Technical failure, timeout, cancellation or insufficient maturity remains retained history; no automatic retry, replacement original or outcome-based budget renewal is authorized.
